lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five sub-parallel horizontal rows. Spot size and inter-spot distance increase significantly from the gill region toward the posterior flank, though mid-body centroids are partially occluded by caustic surface light refraction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a non-uniform grid pattern, most distinguishable in the lower mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, marked by a linear highlight on the dorsal edge and a corresponding linear shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately four distinct high-luminance blobs located primarily on the lower half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) positioned near the ventral surface and trailing the pectoral fin.
